claims: High Point University (HPU) is in North Carolina.
High Point University (HPU) is a private liberal arts institution.
High Point University (HPU) is known as the #1 Best-Run College.
High Point University (HPU) is ranked #1 for Best Regional College in the South for 14 consecutive years.
High Point University (HPU) has a 75% acceptance rate (2024).
High Point University (HPU) tuition for the 2023-2024 academic year is approximately $44,208.
U.S. News & World Report frequently named High Point University (HPU) #1 Best-Run College.
U.S. News & World Report frequently named High Point University (HPU) #1 Best Regional College in the South.
U.S. News & World Report frequently named High Point University (HPU) #1 Most Innovative School.
High Point University (HPU) has expanded to a 600-acre campus.
Dr. Nido Qubein is president of High Point University (HPU).
